summary_text: On this weekday, the user purchased one 250 ml PET bottle of Appy Fizz, a sparkling fruit-flavoured carbonated beverage, during the afternoon. This timing aligns with the population baseline where afternoon shares (0.2526) are lower than morning (0.3246) and evening (0.3027). The product is a single-serve item suitable for immediate refreshment or a quick treat. This is a single observation from one date. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for Appy Fizz, sparkling fruit beverages, or this specific brand over other aerated drinks.
